<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

Make a collection the current working copy. Other working copies keep their stage.

Panel: [Catalog](/docs/reference/cli/panels/catalog/).

## Usage

```text
huron checkout [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

## Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                                                                 |
| ------------ | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | `catalog.namespace.name`. With no argument, the CLI asks you to choose one. |
